notes: Validated against Kang M et al. Nat Chem Biol 2009 (doi:10.1038/nchembio.254). PreQ1 type II riboswitch from T. tengcongensis. Ligand PRF (7-deaza-7-aminomethyl-guanine) at A:34. Guanine moiety H-bonds to A7 (Watson-Crick-like); aminomethyl group at C7 contacts A30-A33. Stacking interactions with flanking nucleotides. SO4 crystallization ions (A:101-104) removed. Different fold from preQ1 type I (4RZD) — H-type pseudoknot vs type I aptamer.
